name: Conversation starters
prompt: Talk to someone you have not seen for a month. Ask three follow-up questions.

name: Clarifying & remembering
prompt: Explain a misunderstanding, then correct something you said.

name: Opinions & priorities
prompt: Compare two weekend plans and explain which you prefer.

name: Agreement & reactions
prompt: Respond to good news, bad news, and an opinion you disagree with.

name: Reasons & connections
prompt: Explain why you changed a plan and what happened as a result.

name: Uncertainty & expectations
prompt: Talk about a plan that is not certain yet. Separate what you know from what you guess.

name: Stories & experiences
prompt: Tell a two-minute story about a day when something went wrong.

name: Time & scheduling
prompt: Describe how your routine now differs from your routine a year ago.

name: Plans & decisions
prompt: Plan a day out with a friend. Discuss two options and a backup plan.

name: Feelings & emotions
prompt: Describe a stressful day and how your feelings changed.

name: People & behaviour
prompt: Describe someone you enjoy spending time with. Give examples of their behaviour.

name: Relationships & social life
prompt: Talk about how you met a friend and how you keep in touch.

name: Problems & solutions
prompt: Explain a recent problem, what you tried, and how you solved it.

name: Change & habits
prompt: Describe a habit you are changing and the progress you have made.

name: Work & responsibilities
prompt: Explain a busy workday, ask for help, and update a colleague.

name: Learning & skills
prompt: Explain what you are learning, what feels difficult, and how you practise.

name: Home & routines
prompt: Describe a typical day at home and three tasks you have been putting off.

name: Money & shopping
prompt: Compare two things you might buy. Explain the price, value, and your budget.

name: Food & eating out
prompt: Describe cooking a meal, then role-play ordering food in a restaurant.

name: Travel & transport
prompt: Tell someone how to reach your home, then describe a difficult journey.

name: Health & energy
prompt: Describe how you feel today and how sleep or exercise affects your energy.

name: Digital life & entertainment
prompt: Explain a problem on a video call, then recommend a series or film.

name: Descriptions & comparisons
prompt: Compare two places you have lived or visited, using specific details.

name: Everyday actions
prompt: Tell a story about losing something and trying to find it.

name: Requests & boundaries
prompt: Make a polite request, turn down an invitation, and apologize for a mistake.

name: Explaining ideas
prompt: Explain a decision, suggest a solution, and persuade a friend to try it.

name: Preferences & interests
prompt: Choose three expressions. Make a true sentence with each, then speak for one minute without reading.

name: Services & bookings
prompt: Choose three expressions. Make a true sentence with each, then speak for one minute without reading.
